main_issue: Whether alcohol can be served at the housewarming in the flat, resolved by putting drinks in a cooler box outside the front door

A-B.evidence: B said it looked good (T2) and A's drinks were fine; both accept the cooler outside (T17, T19).

A-C.evidence: C asked A about the cooler (T15); A agreed 'a cooler outside works for me' (T17).

A-D.evidence: D objected to alcohol (T4, T9); D agreed to outside the door (T14), and A agreed (T17) and said 'settled' (T21).

B-C.evidence: C asked B if the cooler was okay for the manager (T18); B said 'that works for me... Thanks for sorting it out' (T19).

B-D.evidence: B needs drinks for the manager (T10) while D refuses alcohol at home (T9); both later accept the cooler outside (T14, T19).

C-D.evidence: C proposed the kitchen and then the cooler outside; D agreed: 'Outside the door... I can agree to that. Thanks, Agent C' (T14).
